title: Extend membership grace from 3 to 7 days
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Change

A lapsed membership now waits 7 days out from a failed renewal instead of 3, giving a second retry attempt more room to land before the account falls over. See GW-136.

## Testing

Unit coverage on the grace-period window updated for the new figure; suite passes.

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Worth noting for the log: members whose cards had expired were lapsing before we'd even gotten a retry in on the renewal, per GW-136 -- that's the whole reason the window is moving from 3 days to 7.
